name: ibis Bangkok Sathorn
short_description: A budget ibis near Lumpini Park with a 4.4/5 ALL Rating (682 reviews), newly refurbished Superior rooms, and a free shuttle to MRT Lumpini.
ai_summary: ibis Bangkok Sathorn is a short distance from Lumpini Park, Silom Road, and the Patpong Night Market, close to shopping malls. The hotel holds a 4.4/5 ALL Rating from 682 reviews. It offers a free shuttle to the MRT subway, just two stops from Queen Sirikit Convention Center and two BTS SkyTrain stops from Siam Paragon shopping mall, with BTS Saladaeng and MRT Lumpini stations nearby. Rooms include newly refurbished Superior rooms with double or twin beds. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
